profile.headline: I build websites that help businesses grow!
profile.summary:
Creative problem solver with a mind for business and marketing. A reliable and detailed oriented professional with a track record of helping businesses improve their online presence. Strong knowledge and familiarity with a variety of technologies. 

Known for organizational skills, excellent design sense, pleasant attitude and commitment to excellence. Life long learner always looking for ways to improve. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

positions.title: Web Designer and Site Support Specialist
positions.description:
I deliver customized, responsive WordPress sites that help my clients achieve their business goals.

- Work with clients to discover their business pain points, goals, wants and needs.
- Create strategies to accomplish client’s goals while maintaining brand standards.
- Offer monthly support package for clients' sites that includes daily backups, theme and plugin updates, security monitoring, malware scanning, content management assistance, and unlimited 30 minute tasks.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
Use SEO, PPC, Social Media and content creation to promote websites and various products. 

- Create landing pages optimized around a specific Call To Action.
- Create and edit videos for YouTube and other platforms.
- Use Facebook Power Editor to create ads promoting various products.
- Collect opt-in email addresses and integrate with mailing lists.
- Create emails to send out to subscribers on mailing lists.

positions.title: Entertainment Tech
positions.description:
Provide general assistance with Technical Entertainment show/event operations in order to ensure show quality and a positive guest experience.

Completed training to become a greencard venue lead (Tech 2) in December 2016.

positions.title: Web and Digital Technology Consultant
positions.description:
Hired as a digital marketing consultant to oversee Social Media Marketing and Web Development efforts. Goals were to increase brand awareness, provide customer service and increase ticket sales while maintaining brand consistency across all digital platforms.

Digital Marketing

- Content creation for various social media sites such as Facebook, Twitter, YouTube and Pinterest. This included various forms such as photos, videos, text and curated info/links.
- Created an editorial calendar so our team could better visualize our strategy and goals. It also helped to keep track of our content for later analysis.
- Initiated a system to collect (Opt-In) email addresses when guests made show reservations
- Created surveys with SurveyMonkey.com to poll recent guests about their experiences. This helped to hone in on issues that we were not aware of and were then able to fix.
- Used MailChimp to create various marketing and newsletter emails to send to our subscribers.
- Conducted market research using Facebook and Google Analytics to find out more about the demographics of our online audiences.
- Designed various graphics for use in social media and email campaigns
- Worked with various departments to coordinate content efforts to deliver a seamless and consistent message.

Web Development

- Developed company web site and blog using HTML, CSS and PHP with the WordPress content management system.
- Maintained company VPS’s which hosted our website, blog and ticketing systems.
- Identified and successfully resolved technical issues concerning ticketing system and website.
- Maintained WordPress sites by keeping them up to date, making regular backups and keeping them secure.
- Responsible for managing site content through the WordPress CMS.

positions.title: Assistant Stage Manager
positions.description: As an ASM I generally assisted the Stage Manager with the daily management of a group of over 40 performers and stage technicians as well as coordinated our technical team during live performances. Also created the weekly schedules for actors and stage techs using Excel.

positions.title: Audio Engineer
positions.description: Recorded numerous songs and voice overs.  Often times I am asked to edit songs for the show so that they can better fit our specific needs.  I have also recorded many of the vocals that are featured on our musical numbers as well as voice over’s.

positions.title: Audio Visual Technician
positions.description:
Freelance member of an Audio/Visual company that worked on Disney property.  My primary function was to assist in any and all audio/visual setups in numerous Disney resort properties.
•	I quickly developed a reputation amongst the company as one of the more reliable and consistent workers in my hiring class.
•	 Hand picked to be on a team that helped transition two new properties

educations.fieldOfStudy: Digital Audio, Midi, Pro Tools, Sound for Film, Post-Production, Foley
